$comment: Files the base pack renders for this repository's own incubator.json that intentionally differ from (or are absent in) the repository. Every entry needs a reason; the dogfood test fails on unlisted drift and on stale entries.

exceptions.reason: The Incubator's agent instructions describe the monorepo (packages, phases, the brief), not a generated single-package project; they share one body through the same drift check.
The repository README documents the Incubator itself (CLI usage, architecture), not a generated project.
The monorepo CI runs check on three operating systems and the packs matrix; generated repos get the single-job template.
The Incubator's own release lane (package-release plus desktop artifacts) lands with the Electron build in Phase 6.
Monorepo-specific ignores (*.tsbuildinfo, apps/desktop/release/) and no stack marker region.
Repository configuration for the monorepo: workspace-wide steps and profiles, the Incubator's own features, contract pins and reasoned abs-path allowances.
The Incubator was bootstrapped by the phase plans in docs/plans/001-*.md onward, not by a generated bootstrap plan.
Tickets are tracker state created by the local tracker as work happens, not scaffolded.
The Incubator's scenarios exercise its real features (exit codes, discovery); generated repos start from TODO(scaffold) stubs and a health feature.
